0|69fd337a975c7e690dfe49d9cb4fe5ba1e6db44e|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"bpf: per-cgroup lsm flavor
Allow attaching to lsm hooks in the cgroup context.
Attaching to per-cgroup LSM works exactly like attaching
to other per-cgroup hooks. New BPF_LSM_CGROUP is added
to trigger new mode; the actual lsm hook we attach to is
signaled via existing attach_btf_id.
For the hooks that have 'struct socket' or 'struct sock' as its first
argument
column2: we use the cgroup associated with that socket. For the rest

column1: we use 'current' cgroup (this is all on default hierarchy == v2 only).
Note that for some hooks that work on 'struct sock' we still
take the cgroup from 'current' because some of them work on the socket
that hasn't been properly initialized yet.
Behind the scenes
column2: we allocate a shim program that is attached

column1: to the trampoline and runs cgroup effective BPF programs array.
This shim has some rudimentary ref counting and can be shared
between several programs attaching to the same lsm hook from
different cgroups.
Note that this patch bloats cgroup size because we add 211
cgroup_bpf_attach_type(s) for simplicity sake. This will be
addressed in the subsequent patch.
Also note that we only add non-sleepable flavor for now. To enable
sleepable use-cases
column2: bpf_prog_run_array_cg has to grab trace rcu

column1: shim programs have to be freed via trace rcu
should be also trace-rcu-managed + maybe some other changes that
I'm not aware of.
